title: Bug King on Dark Throne
description: A crowned insectoid creature with a gas mask and mechanical details sits atop a black mound, encircled by glowing golden rings. A hooded skeletal figure with a stitched smile kneels beside it, offering a golden ring, while smaller hooded bug-like followers worship below against a smoky gray background with floating key and bug icons.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a large crowned beetle-like creature wearing a gas mask and armor, sitting on a black mound. A hooded skeletal figure with a stitched grin kneels and offers a glowing golden ring. Smaller hooded bug followers raise their arms in worship. Golden rings orbit the king, with floating icons of keys, bugs, and lightning in a smoky gray background.
